The '''OT-12 Battle Droid''' was a large, six-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. OT-12 Battle Droids were among the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] deployed within the [[Okara Droid Factory]] to defend the structure.<ref name="Old Republic" />
